title: Valley of Flowers Trek
reportingPoint: Haridwar. Departure is at 6:30 AM on Day 1, and the group returns to Haridwar by the evening of Day 6. The exact meeting point is shared once your booking is confirmed.

Two nights at Govindghat and three nights at Ghangaria
Alpine flowers in bloom during the monsoon
Pick-up and drop transfers from Haridwar to Haridwar

overview:
The Valley of Flowers is a UNESCO World Heritage Site in the Garhwal Himalayas, part of the Nanda Devi biosphere and national park, and is known for its alpine flowers, which are in full bloom during the monsoon. This **5 Nights / 6 Days** trek also visits Hemkund Sahib. It runs Haridwar to Haridwar: you need to reach Haridwar on your own, and the group leaves at 6:30 AM on Day 1.

Day 1 is the 290 km drive to Govindghat, which takes about 11 hours. Day 2 is a 4 km drive to Pulna and a 9 km trek to Ghangaria. Day 3 is the 4 km trek into the Valley of Flowers and back to Ghangaria. Day 4 is the 6 km trek to Hemkund Sahib (4,329 m), returning to Ghangaria by evening. Day 5 is the 9 km trek back to Govindghat, and Day 6 is the drive back to Haridwar by evening. Transfers from Haridwar, all meals, permits, trekking equipment and a trek leader are included. Batches run from June to September, with departures every Friday. Prices start at ₹10,499 per person (5% GST extra).

itinerary.title: Haridwar to Govindghat (290 km drive)
itinerary.content:
Drive distance: 290 km. Drive time: about 11 hours.
Leave Haridwar early, at 6:30 AM.
Reach Govindghat and check in to the hotel.
Dinner and rest before the trek.

itinerary.title: Govindghat to Ghangaria via Pulna
itinerary.content:
Drive distance: 4 km. Trek distance: 9 km.
After breakfast, take the short 4 km drive to Pulna, where the trek starts.
Trek 9 km to Ghangaria on a well-marked path.
Overnight in Ghangaria.

itinerary.title: Trek to the Valley of Flowers
itinerary.content:
Trek distance: 4 km.
Start early in the morning for the Valley of Flowers.
Spend the day in the valley among the alpine flowers and mountain scenery.
Trek back to Ghangaria for the night.

itinerary.title: Trek to Hemkund Sahib
itinerary.content:
Altitude: 4,329 m. Trek distance: 6 km.
Trek to Hemkund Sahib; the climb is challenging and goes above the treeline.
Visit the Gurudwara.
Return to Ghangaria by evening.

itinerary.title: Return to Govindghat
itinerary.content:
Trek distance: 9 km.
Trek back to Govindghat.
Rest at the hotel and visit the local spiritual sites in the evening.

itinerary.title: Govindghat to Haridwar
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, begin the return journey to Haridwar.
Arrive in Haridwar by evening, where the trip ends.

faqs.q: Where and when does the trek start?
faqs.a: The trek starts from Haridwar, with departure at 6:30 AM on Day 1 for the 290 km drive to Govindghat. The group returns to Haridwar by the evening of Day 6. You travel to and from Haridwar yourself. The exact meeting point is shared once your booking is confirmed.

faqs.q: How much does the Valley of Flowers Trek cost?
faqs.a: ₹10,499 per person. 5% GST is extra. A single or double sharing tent costs extra.
Batches run from June to September, with departures every Friday. The valley is best seen during the monsoon, when the flowers are in full bloom, and August is the most popular month.

Day 2 is a 9 km trek from Pulna to Ghangaria. Day 3 is a 4 km trek into the Valley of Flowers, returning to Ghangaria. Day 4 is a 6 km trek to Hemkund Sahib at 4,329 m, which is the challenging day, returning to Ghangaria by evening. Day 5 is the 9 km trek back to Govindghat.

Pick-up and drop transfers from Haridwar to Haridwar, stay during the trek, all 3 meals plus snacks, trekking and forest permits, campsite fees, trekking equipment, a certified trek leader, a trek crew, safety gear and a trek certificate of completion. Mule offloading (₹400 per day for a bag up to 10 kg) and food on the way during the drives are not included.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A valid government-approved photo ID is a must: there is no boarding without it. Also pack comfortable clothes, sports or trekking shoes, a warm layer for the season, personal medicines and some cash. The full list is under Things To Pack.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Reserve your seat by paying 50% of the trip cost, and pay the rest at least 4 days before the trip. 5% GST is added to the price.

Cancel more than 10 days before the travel date and 50% of the advance is refunded; 5 to 10 days before, 25% of the advance; less than 5 days before, there is no refund. There is no refund for no-shows or early check-outs.
